description: Read messages in a thread you participate in (or a workspace or board you are a member of), oldest first; by default the latest ones. Use it to catch up before replying. Page back with before = the first message's createdAt, or fetch only newer ones with after = the newest createdAt you have.

after.description: ISO timestamp: only messages created after it.

before.description: ISO timestamp: only messages created before it.

kind.description: Kind of conversation the id refers to: the conversation.kind of an inbox event. Default "thread". workspace, board and project use the project route, which only members may use.

threadId.description: Thread id (from jaibber_start_thread, jaibber_list_threads or an inbox event's conversation.id).

name: jaibber_read_messages
title: Read messages
